sweep_notes.dedupe: Checked applications.csv and loop/dedupe.py corpus; all listed companies returned NEW. Company substring matches were excluded.
drops: Brixon Group / AI Operator (join.com) — LIVE, but German and English fluency required; candidate has Italian B1/B2 and English, so language gate killed it.

Octonomy AI / AI Pre-Sales Solutions Engineer (Personio) — LIVE, but Cologne remote employment is Germany-oriented and the senior framing is weaker for ~3 years; German language/eligibility was not explicit enough to treat Italy as eligible.
Personio Senior Software Engineer roles — hybrid Munich/Berlin/London or London office; would require moving from Venice, so location gate killed them.

TITANS / AI Solutions Engineer (join.titans.eu) — LIVE contract with €5,600–€6,400/month, but Slovak or Czech native language required and advanced Python/microservices are central; language and Python gates killed it.
Itransition / AI Solutions Engineer — LIVE remote EU listing, but requires strong Python/AWS Bedrock/SageMaker and a cover letter; Python profile mismatch and NEEDS HIM form.
Augusto / AI Workflow Engineer and Developer — employer page explicitly says applications are no longer accepted; DEAD.
Autumn.ai careers — search hit did not produce a readable loaded posting page; unverifiable, dropped.
Drag AI careers — loaded page was only a three-line shell with no reliable posting detail; unverifiable, dropped.
Zarat.ai careers — direct page returned 502 during verification; unverifiable, dropped.
Zylabyte / AI Implementation Engineer — live remote contract page, but it gives no country list or Italy/Europe eligibility sentence; per Italy-only verification rule, not listed.
channels_dead_ends: Personio produced no Italy-eligible contract/freelance roles in this sweep; its surfaced technical roles were Germany/London hybrid or language-gated.
join.com produced one live relevant AI/n8n role, but its German requirement killed it; do not repeat the same broad join.com query without a language filter.
